_meta.what: Per-era territory: 184 regions as four-corner quads plus a label point, the cell -> region raster, and region -> site id per era
_meta.not: This is a derivation of the 1990 data files, not the files. REGIONS.DAT, OMAP.PIC and the CBR-REGN.DTn text arrays are not in the repo and are not redistributed. There is no picture of the map here, only ids and coordinates.
_meta.layout: REGIONS.DAT: 184 records x 20 bytes; ten big-endian uint16 per record = five (x, y) cell points, label first then the four quad corners. docs/re/REGIONS.md.
